items.title: Albert "Baby Brousse" Broussard Interview, 1961-02-20
items.q: That's where we were living. That's right. Right across from Stanko.

ctx.x: He worked for Lettler, Ye, and Phillip. He worked for Lettler, Ye, and Phillip. That's right. And he... He used to live on St. Peter, between me and I talked to you. Right next door to us. Across the street from Stanko. Across the street from Stanko. From Stanko.
That's where we were living. That's right. Right across from Stanko. That's where...
There's a lot of jobs with him. Oh, man.
